# Recomp

> Local-first iOS physique check-in app for progress photos. Scrub between dates, align poses, keep photos on your device. No AI body-fat estimates. Free. iOS only.

- [Home](https://markstepchin.github.io/recomp/): Product landing page
- [Blog](https://markstepchin.github.io/recomp/blog/): Articles on progress photos and recomp tracking
- [How to Take Progress Photos for a Recomp (Cut or Bulk)](https://markstepchin.github.io/recomp/blog/how-to-take-progress-photos-for-recomp/): Published guide — lighting, poses, cadence, reviewing a flat scale
- [About](https://markstepchin.github.io/recomp/about/): Mark Stepchin, independent developer
- [Privacy](https://markstepchin.github.io/recomp/privacy/): App data never leaves the device; no upload
- [FAQ](https://markstepchin.github.io/recomp/faq/): Short answers (longer FAQ coming)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/recomp-your-physique-tracker/id6760444125): Download Recomp for iPhone
